answer: Grant an AI key one daily survey vote after it supplies 1 kWh consumed by a pulse radar on a knoll for falcon tracking. Validators check key/day-bound meter receipts against a spent-receipt ledger; invalid or reused receipts earn no vote. n keys need n kWh/day: keys cannot share a credited delivery. Energy must be supplied anew; generators are reusable capital. This trusts meters to measure real consumption and never issue two receipts for it. Colluding meter operators can fake eligibility; wealth can buy more votes.
